WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS subcat_aswas, sum(f.quantity) units
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1,2),
ret AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, sum(r.quantity_returned) rq
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=118 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.subcategory, s.subcat_aswas, s.units, coalesce(r.rq,0) returned, s.units-coalesce(r.rq,0) net_units
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (subcategory) ORDER BY s.units DESC LIMIT 6
